41/S0.subgoal: Introduce the Majuli VR tour case study and its primary design objectives.

41/S1.subgoal: Describe the iterative design lifecycle and the identification of user categories and points of interest.

41/S2.subgoal: Describe the design of the tour's starting point and the pre-processing of media assets for a better user experience.

41/S3.subgoal: Explain how visual appearance and ambient sounds were optimized to enhance realism.

41/S4.subgoal: Describe the design of the virtual tablet interface and its interaction features.

41/S5.subgoal: Explain how mini-maps and global maps provide orientation awareness and wayfinding support.

41/S6.subgoal: Describe the techniques used for smooth navigation transitions and long-distance exploration.

41/S7.subgoal: Explain how the system provides access to relevant content and manages user comfort and cyber-sickness.

41/S8.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
